## Enthalpy

$$H = U + PV$$

Placeholder text. Enthalpy is convenient for open systems and constant-pressure processes.

## Energy Balance for a Closed System

$$\Delta U = Q - W$$

- $Q$ — heat added to the system
- $W$ — work done by the system
